overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: because all committee members attended the August 30, 2021 meeting in person, roll call voting was not required even though guests and the public could join remotely.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the committee held a hybrid meeting on August 30, 2021 and failed to take votes by roll call.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, the Committee was not obligated to take votes by roll call during the August 30 meeting, and the Committee did not violate the Open Meeting Law.
